prereg_rule: for every TS r11 requirement, in each of 2 passes, a valid triple (A, B, A' = second request to A, issued together with the sync paused) exists within 3 attempts; valid = A and A' differ only in scalar leaves (V); PASS when for every valid triple: status A == B, content-type A == B, Content-Length header == body length on A and B, no Transfer-Encoding, the JSON leaf paths where A and B differ are a subset of V, and the bodies are byte-equal after replacing the raw values at V by one placeholder
